name: bugtrack-mern
description: BugTrack - a Jira-style issue tracker built with the MERN stack.

scripts.install:all: npm --prefix backend install && npm --prefix frontend install
scripts.dev: concurrently -n api,web -c blue,magenta "npm --prefix backend run dev" "npm --prefix frontend run dev"
scripts.dev:demo: concurrently -n api,web -c blue,magenta "npm --prefix backend run dev:memory" "npm --prefix frontend run dev"
